question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word to fill in the blank in the sentence.**

Deceive

My mother said, “Don’t ________ yourself, Adi. Pay attention to your studies.”
solution:
The correct answer is '**trick**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate **synonym** of the given word '**Deceive**' is '**Trick**'.
 
• **Deceive**: to try to make somebody believe something that is not true. (बहकाना, भ्रमित करना)
 
 
• *Example: He **deceived** his mother into believing that he had earned the money, not stolen it.*
 
 
 
• **Trick**: to make somebody believe something that is not true. (किसी से छल करना)
 
 
• *Example: I’d been **tricked** and I felt like a fool.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *trick.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Shine**: to send out or to send back (reflect) light; to be bright. (चमकाना या चमक बिखेरना; चमकना)
 
• **Handle**: to touch or hold something with your hand(s). (हाथ से छूना या सँभालना)
 
• **Believe**: to feel sure that something is true or that somebody is telling the truth. (विश्‍वास करना, सही मान लेना)
